info.description:
Fleet orchestrator for the Bittle robot dog. Routes under /api/robots/{robotId} address one robot; most of them relay to the same path on that robot's Python adapter, so their bodies are the adapter's JSON and are typed as plain objects.

Errors use the envelope {"error": code, "message": text}: 404 robot_not_found, 400 bad_request, 409 behavior_loop_running or behavior_loop_held_elsewhere, and 502 adapter_unavailable when the adapter cannot be reached. Error responses from the adapter itself are forwarded verbatim with their status.

Operations marked deprecated belong to the adapter's old brain and are scheduled for removal.
